# Adaptive Security — market positioning (2026-10-13)

**Canonical entity:** Adaptive Security — https://www.adaptivesecurity.com/  
**Do not conflate:** Adaptive Shield (SSPM; https://www.adaptive-shield.com/), a separate vendor already in this map.

## Market taxonomy
- Primary: human risk management; security awareness training (SAT), phishing simulation, AI-enabled social engineering and deepfake readiness
- Adjacent products: email threat protection / agentic email security; phishing triage; enterprise AI governance / shadow AI visibility
- Buyer hypotheses: CISO, security awareness program owner, messaging/email security, SOC, security operations, security/GRC for AI acceptable use. Validate by product line.

## Product and competition hypotheses
| Motion | Adaptive positioning | Compare / validate |
|---|---|---|
| Train | Automated awareness and role-based personalized training | KnowBe4, Hoxhunt, Proofpoint Security Awareness |
| Test | Email, SMS, voice, deepfake simulation | Hoxhunt, KnowBe4, Cofense |
| Protect | AI-oriented email security and user-reported phish triage | Abnormal AI, Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender, Mimecast |
| Govern | AI tool usage visibility/control, shadow AI, risk-linked training | Microsoft Purview, Netskope, dedicated AI governance platforms |

Comparisons are research candidates, NOT claims of direct feature parity or proven displacement.
